name: AI Platform Engineer
target: Infrastructure beneath AI products — serving, retrieval, evaluation, cost.

content.summary: AI platform engineer who takes systems from architecture to production on both Azure and AWS — model serving, queue-backed inference, CI/CD, observability and cost. Owns the HLD, LLD and deployment design for five government platforms now running in production, including a multilingual assistant live on kheloindia.gov.in and a drafting system piloted in a live 2026 Parliament session. Re-platformed one service onto ECS Fargate and cut another's run-rate ~60%.

blocks.title: Khelo India Knowledge Assistant — live in production on kheloindia.gov.in

bullets.text: Owned the full Azure deployment: App Service API and worker off one image, Postgres Flexible with pgvector, Managed Redis in OSS cluster mode (hash-tagged keyspace for same-slot reads), Service Bus job queue, Blob ingestion and ACR with Managed Identity pull.

Built the streaming path — API enqueues a job, the worker publishes tokens to Redis pub/sub, the API relays SSE — plus a two-layer cache, idempotency keys and 14 feature flags including an instant kill switch needing no redeploy.

Added a Hindi/English voice channel (built, in UAT) as a thin gateway (Pipecat 1.11: Silero VAD → Sarvam STT → HTTP SSE to the bot → Sarvam TTS) with no KB and no LLM, so voice and chat cannot drift; provider fail-fast on the first 401/402/403, key masking in every log line, 20s/25s brain timeouts. Time-to-first-token 12.6s → 9.1s; 40 gateway tests.

blocks.title: PQ-Bot — Parliamentary Question drafting platform · MYAS / Sports Authority of India

bullets.text: Sole engineer on a ~60,000-LOC AWS Bedrock platform (95 endpoints, 34 tables, 33 migrations) piloted during the 2026 Parliament monsoon session; tuned the concurrency model — raised anyio worker limits, a shared fan-out executor, a 50-connection Bedrock pool and explicit transaction release before long LLM blocks so idle-in-transaction timeouts cannot kill connections.

Wrote the host-agnostic CI gate driven by Jenkins off an OpenForge/Tuleap webhook, plus 21 feature flags, a Redis semantic cache and eval harnesses that gate releases; 312 backend tests green, SAST closed at zero critical findings.

blocks.title: MYAS Task Tracker & Khelo India Expenditure Tracker — internal platforms, in production

bullets.text: Authored the architecture, HLD/LLD and deployment design for both; re-platformed onto ECS Fargate (ARM64) + RDS Postgres 16 + ALB/WAF with a GitHub OIDC pipeline whose migrations run as an in-VPC one-off task and abort the deploy on failure. Expenditure platform tracks ₹924 Cr across 14 regional centres.

experience.context: Oracle Cloud Partner — 20+ enterprise clients including Aditya Birla Group, Adani, and Acko.

bullets.text: Architected a Docker + GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline on AWS EC2 + Nginx, cutting deploy time 80% (15 min to under 3) with zero-downtime rolling releases, saving ~2 hrs of manual effort per cycle.

Engineered a real-time inventory backend (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis) automating 3 reconciliation workflows, eliminating ~4 hrs/day of ops overhead, and consolidating 15+ scattered permission checks into one JWT RBAC middleware layer.

experience.context: Ed-tech platform delivering courses in web development, ML, and embedded systems to students across India.

bullets.text: Reduced frontend render latency by ~28% on a live multi-user ML platform (React DevTools Profiler) via React.memo and lazy loading — zero backend changes, zero regressions.
Built vendor-agnostic normalisation adapters over third-party ML APIs, fully decoupling business logic from vendor schemas and making future API swaps non-breaking.
